title: Evaluate dynamic-page fetch ownership
description: Use representative failed-fetch fixtures to decide whether JS/browser rendering or a remote extraction service belongs in pi-search. Prefer Pi/Bash/browser workflows when they are more reliable and cheaper; if added, define a separate SSRF, subresource, resource, cancellation, privacy, and cost boundary.

logs.msg: Closed dynamic-page ownership evaluation. Direct pinned HTTP plus local Markdown/Readability/Turndown/PDF/caption extraction remains the efficient default. Browser/JS or remote extraction is deferred until representative failed-page fixtures justify a separate SSRF, resource, privacy, cancellation, and cost boundary; Pi/Bash/browser workflows remain available.
